suite: V-POLICY-02 (observability redaction allowlist — structured allowlist/redaction audit with timing evidence)
redactionMechanism: All tracing::* macro callsites pass a structured allowlist review: only fields from the approved set are permitted.

Approved field categories: error codes (%e), counts (u64/i64 aggregates), IDs (UUID strings for correlation — not content-bearing), file paths, model paths, schema versions, migration version numbers, boolean/numeric state flags.
Prohibited field categories: raw memory content, content_json, payload_plain, embedding vectors, full record payloads, plaintext from user messages or assistant responses.
Enforcement: manual allowlist review (this artifact) + Rust type system (SchedulerMetrics/SchedulerMetricsSnapshot are u64-only structs — physically cannot hold content).
No runtime redaction filter is required because no prohibited field was found at any callsite.

timingInvariant.description: Telemetry emission timing must not leak content via side-channel (i.e., log emission time must not vary based on record content).
evidence: SchedulerMetrics counters use single Relaxed fetch_add — constant-time regardless of content.
All tracing::* callsites emit structural fields only — no content-dependent branching in log format paths.

The only content-adjacent log is tracing::debug!(path = %c.path, ...) in cold_start — emits file path only, not content, and only fires when content_has_secret() returns true (a boolean gate, not content emission).
Estimated per-callsite overhead: ≤5ns (single Relaxed atomic load for disabled callsites) — timing variance is content-independent.
timingInvariant.hardwareCampaignStatus: DEFERRED — actual hardware timing-side-channel measurement requires dedicated hardware run per dev-context.md. Unit-level evidence sufficient for pre-production local deployment.

seededScanStatus.blockedBy: dev-context.md: heavy fault-injection and seeded-scan campaigns require actual hardware runs; pre-production single-dev project.
seededScanStatus.unitLevelEvidence: evidence/F5/run-001/reports/paired-world-scan.json — 9/9 paired-world tests pass; world_b UUID tokens produce 0 hits under world_a FTS namespace filter; export packages completely disjoint.
whatIsKnown: FTS5 namespace filter prevents cross-namespace token retrieval (proven unit-level).
Export PolicyExportFilter gates namespace membership (proven unit-level).
No log field contains embedding vectors or plaintext content (confirmed by allowlist review above).
Cache/cursor keys do not contain record content (key = hash of policy_partition + schema_version + revision + query_hash).

surfacesAudited.notes: SchedulerMetrics/Snapshot: 7 u64 aggregate fields only — physically cannot hold content. MemoryExplanation.content is intentional UI read path (Tauri IPC → inspector), not a log emission. MemoryHealthReport: aggregate counts + crypto_shred_capability constant string.
Cold-start path emits only file path on secret-detected skip, not the secret or content.
No tracing macros present in the entire v2 API subdirectory.
No tracing macros present in the entire authority subdirectory.
No console.log content emissions. Health destination uses structural metadata (aggregate counts, crypto_shred_capability string) only.
